_note: Hero 7 (docs/plans/design/rebuild-heroes.md section 8g; rebuild-phase8-severine-edric.md 8e-1). Stats, mana, Rend, Drain, and Hemophage are the design's; Rend's 1.1s cooldown is a first number. She never heals: all her sustain is lifesteal. She can't be drafted until her paths come.
name: Severine Hollowell
title: the bloodwitch

basic_attack.name: Rend
basic_attack.text: A clawing strike at the enemy beside her that heals her by part of the damage. Where most of her mana comes from.

signature.name: Drain
signature.text: She tears into an enemy within 1 hex and drinks: a heavy strike that heals her by half the damage.

passives.name: Hemophage
passives.text: Her lifesteal is doubled against enemies below half their HP.
